name: VividCart – AI Product Images for WooCommerce
author: techartdev

sections.description:
VividCart turns your WooCommerce product editor into an AI photo studio. Generate brand-new product images or restage your existing photos into beautiful scenes — directly from the product edit screen, using your own AI provider API key.

Unlike credit-based services, VividCart never resells AI usage. You connect your own OpenAI or Google Gemini key and pay your provider directly — typically just a few cents per image, at wholesale token prices. We provide the workflow; you keep the savings.

Free features

  • Generate product images from the product editor — product name and category are woven into the prompt automatically
  • Edit existing photos: replace backgrounds and restage your real product shots with AI reference-image editing
  • 14 scene presets: Studio White, Marble Counter, Rustic Wood, Bright Kitchen, Outdoor, Flat-lay, Gradient, Botanical, Urban Loft, Beach, Holiday, Luxury Dark, Soft Pastel, Custom
  • One-click apply as the product image or gallery image — every result is saved to the Media Library, your originals are never touched
  • Brand style notes appended to every prompt for a consistent catalog look
  • Automatic SEO alt text on generated images
  • History of your latest generations with one-click re-apply
  • Works with OpenAI (gpt-image) and Google Gemini image models, with live model discovery
  • Your keys are stored encrypted in your own database; your prompts and images travel only between your server and your chosen AI provider

VividCart Pro

Need catalog-scale workflows? VividCart Pro adds: Bulk Studio with review-before-apply, Fidelity Mode (pixel-exact product preservation — AI builds the scene, your product pixels stay untouched), Brand Kit templates, 4 variants per run, upscaling, bulk alt text, auto-pilot for new products, badge composer and more providers (Stability AI, Flux, fal.ai).

Why store owners pick VividCart

  • No subscriptions for tokens — your own key means provider wholesale pricing and no middleman markup
  • No watermarks, no expiring credits, no trial traps — the free plugin is free, forever
  • Product-first design — built for WooCommerce product photography, not a generic image toy

External services

This plugin connects to the AI provider you choose and configure. No data is sent anywhere until you enter an API key and start a generation.

OpenAI (api.openai.com) — used to generate or edit images when you select OpenAI as provider. Sent: your prompt, product name/category (for context), the source image you chose to edit, and your own API key for authentication. Sent only when you click Generate or Test. Terms of use · Privacy policy

Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com) — used to generate or edit images and to list available models when you select Google Gemini as provider. Sent: your prompt, product name/category, the source image you chose to edit, and your own API key for authentication. Sent only when you click Generate or Test (model listing runs after you save a key). Terms of service · Privacy policy

The plugin sends no data to Tech Art EOOD and contains no tracking or telemetry.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Go to VividCart AI in your admin menu.
  3. Paste your Google Gemini API key (free to obtain at aistudio.google.com/apikey) and/or your OpenAI key, then press Test.
  4. Open any product — the VividCart AI Studio box is below the editor. Pick a scene, click Generate, apply. Done.
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for AI usage?

You pay your AI provider directly through your own account — typically $0.01–$0.07 per image depending on model and quality. Note: Google’s image models require a billing-enabled account (the free tier does not include image generation). VividCart adds no markup.

Is my API key safe?

Keys are stored encrypted (libsodium, keyed off your site’s salts) in your own database and are only ever sent to the provider you configured, over HTTPS.

Will it overwrite my product photos?

Never. Every generation is a new Media Library attachment. Applying an image just changes which attachment the product points to; originals stay in your library.

Which models are supported?

OpenAI gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5 and gpt-image-1-mini; Google Gemini image models are discovered live from your account, so new models appear automatically.

Does it work with my theme / page builder?

Yes. VividCart works at the WooCommerce data level (product image and gallery), so whatever renders your store renders VividCart’s images.
